prompts.theme: Good medieval realm, retain the existing warm ivory limestone, cream plaster, honey-brown timber and friendly craftsmanship of reference 1. Change the deep cobalt roofs and banner to noticeably lighter sky blue matching #3498DB. Keep the established window and door designs very close to reference 1; simple elegant stone arches.
prompts.prompt:
Regenerate the FIRST reference image as one square production game texture atlas for a single faction. The second reference is ONLY a color/theme guide; never reproduce its text, labels, or swatch chart. Create exactly one texture image, front-facing orthographic flat surface albedo, hand-painted stylized Polyworld fantasy game materials matching reference 1's brushwork, tactile readable bevels and restrained ambient shading. No rendered buildings, perspective, external background, title, labels, borders, padding, grid lines or gutters.
CRITICAL UV CONTRACT: exactly FOUR equal columns by FOUR equal rows, boundaries at precisely 25%, 50%, 75% on both axes. Sixteen square tiles fill 100% of image. Preserve each tile's identity, location, object extent and UV orientation from reference 1. No swapping, merging, extra tiles, and nothing may cross a boundary.
Row 1 left to right: [1] coursed architectural block masonry; [2] broad plain plaster or earthen wall surface without objects; [3] centered framed four-pane square window with dark glass filling almost entire tile; [4] secondary load-bearing stone masonry.
Row 2: [1] repeating overlapping SHINGLES with same row pattern as reference, painted faction color; [2] close-up vertical timber grain with no objects; [3] raw yellow GOLD ORE nuggets filling the tile, only this tile contains precious metal, preserve the natural ore reference; [4] full-tile straight-on SINGLE wood plank door, two dark iron horizontal straps and centered ring pull.
Row 3: [1] close-up orange PUMPKIN SKIN vertical ribbing, no full pumpkin silhouette; [2] full-tile faction-colored woven CLOTH, ONE SMALL centered ivory sword insignia, maximum one-third tile height, ample empty fabric around it, dark insignia only if necessary for yellow cloth contrast; [3] dense natural GREEN LEAVES surface swatch, recognizable overlapping leaves, no grass landscape; [4] full-tile DOUBLE wooden doors, centered vertical seam, dark iron bands and paired ring pulls.
Row 4: [1] vertical tree BARK surface; [2] brown tilled SOIL surface with horizontal furrows; [3] centered TALL framed window in stone surround with dark glass, arch or square lintel as faction theme specifies; [4] centered TALL wooden door in stone surround with iron straps and ring, arch or square lintel as theme specifies.
Natural resources must remain natural across all factions: orange pumpkin skin, green leaf tile, brown bark/soil/timber, yellow raw gold. Faction hue belongs strongly on roof shingles and banner cloth. Change building materials and door/window frame shapes to the specified theme, keeping their exact tile placement. No blue magical glow, crystals, extra symbols, metal gold panels or gold trim. Window glass dark desaturated slate. Texture must be readable when reduced to 512x512 (each tile 128x128). Produce a clean square high-resolution texture atlas only.

Subtle funerary geometric grooves in stone frames, heavy dark iron door straps. No hieroglyph text, no skulls, no gold trim; raw gold appears only in its ore tile.
prompts.prompt:
Regenerate the FIRST reference image as one square production game texture atlas for a single faction. The second reference is ONLY a color/theme guide; never reproduce its text, labels, or swatch chart. Create exactly one texture image, front-facing orthographic flat surface albedo, hand-painted stylized Polyworld fantasy game materials matching reference 1's brushwork, tactile readable bevels and restrained ambient shading. No rendered buildings, perspective, external background, title, labels, borders, padding, grid lines or gutters.
CRITICAL UV CONTRACT: exactly FOUR equal columns by FOUR equal rows, boundaries at precisely 25%, 50%, 75% on both axes. Sixteen square tiles fill 100% of image. Preserve each tile's identity, location, object extent and UV orientation from reference 1. No swapping, merging, extra tiles, and nothing may cross a boundary.
Row 1 left to right: [1] coursed architectural block masonry; [2] broad plain plaster or earthen wall surface without objects; [3] centered framed four-pane square window with dark glass filling almost entire tile; [4] secondary load-bearing stone masonry.
Row 2: [1] repeating overlapping SHINGLES with same row pattern as reference, painted faction color; [2] close-up vertical timber grain with no objects; [3] raw yellow GOLD ORE nuggets filling the tile, only this tile contains precious metal, preserve the natural ore reference; [4] full-tile straight-on SINGLE wood plank door, two dark iron horizontal straps and centered ring pull.
Row 3: [1] close-up orange PUMPKIN SKIN vertical ribbing, no full pumpkin silhouette; [2] full-tile faction-colored woven CLOTH, ONE SMALL centered ivory sword insignia, maximum one-third tile height, ample empty fabric around it, dark insignia only if necessary for yellow cloth contrast; [3] dense natural GREEN LEAVES surface swatch, recognizable overlapping leaves, no grass landscape; [4] full-tile DOUBLE wooden doors, centered vertical seam, dark iron bands and paired ring pulls.
Row 4: [1] vertical tree BARK surface; [2] brown tilled SOIL surface with horizontal furrows; [3] centered TALL framed window in stone surround with dark glass, arch or square lintel as faction theme specifies; [4] centered TALL wooden door in stone surround with iron straps and ring, arch or square lintel as theme specifies.
Natural resources must remain natural across all factions: orange pumpkin skin, green leaf tile, brown bark/soil/timber, yellow raw gold. Faction hue belongs strongly on roof shingles and banner cloth. Change building materials and door/window frame shapes to the specified theme, keeping their exact tile placement. No blue magical glow, crystals, extra symbols, metal gold panels or gold trim. Window glass dark desaturated slate. Texture must be readable when reduced to 512x512 (each tile 128x128). Produce a clean square high-resolution texture atlas only.
FACTION 8/8: SunFlower. Exact accent color: #F1C40F.

prompts.symbol_edit_prompt: Edit this game texture atlas in exactly ONE place: the flag/cloth tile at row 3, column 2 (counting from the top left, in the existing 4x4 grid). Replace the current sword insignia with One small dark-charcoal SCARAB beetle emblem, symmetrical oval body, head and three legs each side, no wings or circle. Center it on the cloth and keep it SMALL: at most one third of the cloth tile height and one third its width. Use a clean hand-painted graphic that remains readable at 512x512 atlas resolution (128px per tile). Retain the existing cloth color, folds, weave, and lighting. Erase the old sword completely. All other FIFTEEN tiles and every tile boundary must remain pixel-layout-identical in content, geometry, colors and proportions to the reference. Do not change any building material, shingle color, gold ore, windows, doors, pumpkins, leaves, bark, soil, or image dimensions. No extra insignias, text, margins, gutters, or rearrangement. Output just the entire edited square atlas.
